splash.tagline: Stay close to the people you love

lang.sub: Select the language for the app. The whole layout will follow your choice.
lang.later: You can change the language at any time in More → Settings → Language.

login.title: Sign in to stay connected
login.sub: See updates, documents and messages about your loved one from the care center.
login.errBody_one: The phone number or password is incorrect. You have {{count}} attempt left before your account is temporarily locked.
login.errBody_other: The phone number or password is incorrect. You have {{count}} attempts left before your account is temporarily locked.
login.errField: Check your password and try again
login.idHelp: Use the phone number the care center registered for you.
login.acctTitle: Your account is created by the care center
login.acctBody: You can't register on your own. If you don't have login details, contact the social worker at
login.offline: Connect to the internet to sign in.

password.offline: Connect to the internet to save your password.

firstPw.title: Create your personal password
firstPw.sub: You signed in with a temporary password from the care center. For your security, choose a personal password before you continue.
firstPw.hint: Meet all the rules to continue

forgot.phoneSub: We'll send a 6-digit code by SMS to the phone number the care center registered for you.
forgot.phoneNote: No longer using this number? Contact the care center to update your details.
forgot.codeSub: We sent a code by SMS to
forgot.codeNote: The code is valid for 10 minutes. Never share it with anyone, including care center staff.
forgot.codeInvalid_one: The code is incorrect. {{count}} attempt left.
forgot.codeInvalid_other: The code is incorrect. {{count}} attempts left.
forgot.codeExpired: The code expired. Send a new one.
forgot.tooManyAttempts: Too many incorrect codes. Request a new code to try again.
forgot.pwSub: Choose a password you have not used before in this app.
forgot.doneBody: You can now sign in with your new password. For your security, we signed you out on all other devices.

locked.title: Account temporarily locked
locked.body: After {{attempts}} incorrect sign-in attempts, we locked your account for {{minutes}} minutes to protect your family member's information.
locked.waitBody: You can try again at {{time}}. Check that the phone number is the one registered with the center.
locked.resetBody: We will send a 6-digit code to your registered phone.

blocked.title: Access to your account is blocked
blocked.body: The care center has deactivated access for this account. This can happen when family contact details change or at the request of the resident's guardian. Your information is safe.

picker.title: Who would you like to view?
picker.sub_one: Your account is linked to {{count}} resident at {{center}}. Choose one to see their updates.
picker.sub_other: Your account is linked to {{count}} residents at {{center}}. Choose one to see their updates.
picker.note: You can switch at any time from the top of the screen. Linked residents are managed by the care center.

session.title: Enter your password to continue
session.sub_one: For your privacy, we hid the content after {{count}} minute without activity.
session.sub_other: For your privacy, we hid the content after {{count}} minutes without activity.
